name: pharmacy-management-system
description: SE421 pharmacy management system - Milestone 1 foundation

scripts.desktop:setup: node scripts/setup-desktop-runtime.mjs && npm run desktop:npm -- install && npm run desktop:electron:install
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/api && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/desktop && node scripts/with-desktop-node.mjs node scripts/desktop.mjs
scripts.test:desktop:lifecycle: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/api && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/desktop && node scripts/with-desktop-node.mjs node scripts/test-desktop.mjs
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/shared && npm run dev --workspace @pharmacy/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/shared && npm run dev --workspace @pharmacy/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/api && npm run build --workspace @pharmacy/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration --workspace @pharmacy/api
scripts.db:logs: docker compose --env-file infrastructure/docker/.env -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml logs --tail=50 postgres
